name: John Curiel
office: Westside Union School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: John Curiel is vice president of the Westside Union School District Governing Board. His current term expires in November 2026. He was elected to the board in 2005 and re-elected in 2022. He served as board president in 2018. He was serving as a trustee when the district extended its Expanded Learning Opportunities Program for transitional kindergarten through sixth-grade students to nine hours on non-school days, under an agreement with the Antelope Valley Boys & Girls Club.
